findings.text: extract_review_worker's _load_all_names still projects sn.source_paths, so the production review pipeline (imported at imas_codex/cli/sn.py:6689) remains a reader that answers from the copied list; its source_paths feeds the DD-documentation fetch at pipeline.py:767/878/956 and review_input_hash at pipeline.py:343, so the goal's "every reader" is still unmet for one live reader, and the repair of the previous review's cli loader stopped at the file that finding named.

the artifact records "command": "imas-codex sn sourceless --json", but its key set (counted, live_names_total, live_names_with_producer, exempt_entries, rule) appears in no revision of imas_codex/standard_names/source_reads.py or the CLI command in this range (the report returns count, names, exempt_derived_parents, bare_count, bare_names, differing_names), and no code in the tree writes this path, so section 7 cannot regenerate the population from the command the done_when names.
